components.css: .ds-section-nav{font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;display:flex;gap:4px 24px;flex-wrap:wrap;border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#cbd3d5);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#cbd3d5);margin-bottom:25px}.ds-section-nav a{color:var(--blue,#245a8d);display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;text-decoration:none;font-size:18px;font-weight:600}.ds-section-nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-section-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#0765ca);outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-section-nav{gap:0 20px}.ds-section-nav a{font-size:17px}}

components.name: Native count disclosure
components.description: Native details/summary with ruled boundaries and a count-list alternative; sample entries preserve actual counts.
components.css: .ds-count-list{color:var(--ink,#202f35);font-family:'Source Sans 3',sans-serif;border-top:1px solid var(--rule,#cbd3d5);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule,#cbd3d5);margin-top:15px}.ds-count-list summary{min-height:44px;padding:11px 0;font-size:16px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}.ds-count-list summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus,#0765ca);outline-offset:3px}.ds-count-list ul{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:7px 25px;list-style:none;padding:4px 0 15px;margin:0}.ds-count-list li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:16px}.ds-count-list strong{font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}@media(max-width:600px){.ds-count-list ul{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}

limits: Paused native controls cover part of Barbara Bush's burned-in caption; the outside-player caption stays clear.
Public deployment and Teaching HQ linking are outside the artifact review verdict.

narrative.overview: The built October 7 page preserves the existing Blood Dazzler reading-page world. Official remarks appear first, separate evacuation testimony follows, and the canonical pp. 25–49 frequency cloud appears last.

rules.name: The Native Player Rule
rules.body: Keep browser controls and direct-file access with each video.

rules.name: The Count Preservation Rule
rules.body: Preserve every canonical word/count pair and the count and method disclosures when changing layout.

dos: Do preserve the existing Blood Dazzler palette and local Source Sans 3 typography.
Do keep official remarks together on desktop and stacked on phones, with evacuation testimony separate below.
Do keep the cloud words at least 20 screen pixels and confine sideways scrolling to the cloud region.
Do keep source dates, credits, direct media links, canonical counts, and native disclosures visible or available.
donts: Don't add a hero, slogan, new identity, task, or character analysis to this requested resource page.
Don't substitute a remote embed for the verified local native players or add autoplay.
Don't describe the Brownie repetitions as repeated statements at the original event.
Don't turn this surface record into a replacement for the shared design system.
Don't treat unverified listening or obscured paused subtitles as verified quality guarantees.

notCanonized: Paused subtitle occlusion is recorded as a limit, not a design rule.
Compact inherited phone breadcrumb targets are recorded in the extracted snippet, not prescribed as a new interaction standard.
No synthetic tonal ramp, new component, global palette repair, comp, seed, or QUALITY BAR artifact was created.
